title: Log-optimal two-sample testing by betting
abstract: arXiv:2611.19062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For each standard Borel observation space, we construct a single anytime-valid two-sample procedure that is asymptotically log-optimal for every pair of unknown probability laws and every limiting ratio of diverging sample sizes, including zero and infinity. For independent balanced pairs, the optimal log-wealth rate is $2\JS(P,Q)$, where $\JS$ is the Jensen--Shannon divergence. Unequal sizes yield weighted Jensen--Shannon information and the one-sample limit $\log W(n_1,n_2)/n_2\to\KL(Q\|P)$ when $n_1/n_2\to\infty$. Refining finite partitions and logarithmic-loss learning with measurable characteristic kernels provide universal constructions. Our main contribution is the generality of our construction, and its connections to classical batch efficiency notions. Practical implementations allow continuous classifier fine-tuning, as demonstrated on finite alphabets, Gaussian data, and handwritten digits.

translated_title: 基于打赌的对数最优双样本检验
translated_abstract: 对于每个标准Borel观测空间，我们构建了一个统一的任意时刻有效双样本检验程序，该程序对于每一对未知概率分布以及任意发散样本量的极限比率（包括零和无穷）都是渐近对数最优的。对于独立且平衡的样本对，最优对数财富增长率为 $2\JS(P,Q)$，其中 $\JS$ 为Jensen–Shannon散度。当样本量不等时，该增长率变为加权Jensen–Shannon信息；当 $n_1/n_2\to\infty$ 时，得到单样本极限 $\log W(n_1,n_2)/n_2\to\KL(Q\|P)$。通过细化有限划分以及使用可测特征核的对数损失学习，我们提供了普适性的构造方法。我们的主要贡献在于该构造的普适性及其与经典批量效率概念之间的联系。实际实现允许对分类器进行持续微调，并在有限字母表、高斯数据和手写数字上进行了演示。
tldr: 本文针对标准Borel观测空间构造了一个统一的、任意时刻有效的打赌式双样本检验方法，对所有未知分布对及任意样本量比率均渐近对数最优，其最优对数财富增长率由Jensen–Shannon散度刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a single anytime-valid betting-based two-sample testing procedure on standard Borel spaces that is asymptotically log-optimal for every pair of unknown distributions and every sample-size ratio, with the optimal log-wealth rate characterized by the Jensen–Shannon divergence.
